in_marathi.name: Nivrutti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nivrutti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nivrutti is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'Nivrutt' which means 'to desire, to long for, to attain'. This name symbolizes the fulfillment of deepest desires and longings. In Hindu mythology, Nivrutti is the name of a goddess who represents the fulfillment of all desires, especially the desires of the devotees. She is often depicted with four arms, holding a bowl of offerings in one hand, a conch shell in another, a lotus flower in the third, and a bowl of water in the fourth.
